original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-precompose-property-local-source}
Let $\tau \in \{fpqc, fppf, syntomic, smooth, \etale, Zariski\}$.
Let $\mathcal{P}$ be a property of morphisms which is $\tau$ local
on the source. Let $f : X \to Y$ have property $\mathcal{P}$.
For any morphism $a : X' \to X$ which is
flat, resp.\ flat and locally of finite presentation, resp.\ syntomic,
resp.\ \'etale, resp.\ an open immersion, the composition
$f \circ a : X' \to Y$ has property $\mathcal{P}$.

final_content.statement: Let $\tau$ be one of Zariski, fpqc, fppf, étale, smooth, or syntomic. A property $\mathcal P$ of morphisms of schemes is *$\tau$-local on the source* if for every $f:X\to Y$ and every $\tau$-covering $\{a_i:X_i\to X\}$ one has $\mathcal P(f)$ if and only if $\mathcal P(f\circ a_i)$ for every $i$. If $\mathcal P$ is $\tau$-local on the source and $f:X\to Y$ has $\mathcal P$, then for any $a:X'\to X$ in the class corresponding to $\tau$—flat for fpqc; flat locally finitely presented for fppf; syntomic for syntomic; smooth for smooth; étale for étale; open immersion for Zariski—the composite $f\circ a:X'\to Y$ has $\mathcal P$.
hypotheses: P is tau-local on source; f has P; a is an indicated tau-type map.
